checks.description: Every fault current path resolves on the routed copper (pads found, no open islands)
checks.limit_source: suite integrity

notes: Fault currents are bounded by the source limits: brick OCP (GST160A24 class, 105-150 %), each regulator's datasheet current limit (part_models.csv), DPS 5 A CC.
Clearing times use datasheet maxima; F1 below 135 % of rating may never open (Littelfuse 297 table).

Track temperatures: nodal solve of each net's routed copper (segments split at T-junctions, THT pads join layers) then the IPC-2152 (Brooks & Adam) external fit per segment; GND is a pour and is not assessed.
